specification.equation: Y_mt = alpha_m + f(A_mt, X_mt, year_t) + u_mt
specification.f_decomposition: f(A, X, t) = b_t + g(A, X, t)
specification.commune_effect: unpenalized additive intercept; no commune input in g
specification.year_main_effect: unpenalized b_t inside f; first observed year normalized to zero
specification.time_kernel: categorical year indicators; bandwidth selected by held-out integrated loss
specification.interactions: full immigration x demographics x categorical-year product kernel
specification.feature_absorption: commune and year main effects projected from integrated second-stage features and outcomes; raw A never demeaned
specification.causal_interpretation: requires valid panel IV moments and identification of the nonlinear response; not established by fitting
specification.first_stage: conditional Gaussian density mixture with nonnegative normalized kernel weights
specification.structural_class: signed linear combinations of Gaussian bumps at observed (A, age, male share, year)

time_heterogeneity.support_rule: within each year's 5th-95th marginal intervals and empirical 3D convex hull for A/age/male share
time_heterogeneity.support_caveat: Empirical overlap screen; not a conditional instrument-support or identification test.

solver.solver: SVD minimum-Euclidean-norm least squares, LAPACK gelsd
solver.rank_note: Cutoff is machine precision times matrix dimension, not a tuned statistical penalty. Rank deficiency selects a minimum-norm solution.

density_bandwidth_selection.selection_loss: held-out conditional-density negative log likelihood; folds grouped by commune

structural_bandwidth_selection.selection_loss: commune-held-out integrated NPIV squared loss after absorbing additive effects
structural_bandwidth_selection.caveat: The minimum CV loss selects bandwidths; it is not an independent assessment of the selected structural model.
structural_bandwidth_selection.heldout_effects: Outcome and integrated features are projected on held-out commune/year indicators for within-panel validation, not outcome-level forecasting.
